import requests, os, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
B62_TXT="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2

G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n"); cols=ls[0].split()
M=np.full((128,128),-4,np.int16)
for row in ls[1:]:
    p=row.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): M[ord(p[0]),ord(c)]=int(v)
def enc(s): return np.frombuffer(s.encode(),dtype=np.uint8).astype(np.int32)
def sw_map(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.float32); ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Fprev=np.full(m+1,-1e9,np.float32); best=(0.0,0,0)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        srow=M[a[i-1],b].astype(np.float32)
        Hprev=H[i-1]; Hcur=H[i]; pcur=ptr[i]
        Fcur=np.maximum(Fprev+ge,Hprev+go); e=-1e9
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            e=max(e+ge,Hcur[j-1]+go); f=Fcur[j]; dg=Hprev[j-1]+srow[j-1]
            v=dg
            if e>v: v=e
            if f>v: v=f
            if v<0: v=0.0
            Hcur[j]=v; pcur[j]=1 if v==dg else (2 if v==e else (3 if v==f else 0))
            if v>best[0]: best=(v,i,j)
        Fprev=Fcur
    v,i,j=best; mp={}
    while i>0 and j>0 and H[i,j]>0:
        p=ptr[i,j]
        if p==1: mp[i-1]=j-1; i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==2: j-=1
        elif p==3: i-=1
        else: break
    return v,mp
def up(q,size=200):
    r=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",params={"query":q,"format":"fasta","size":size},timeout=180); r.raise_for_status()
    d={};n=None
    for l in r.text.splitlines():
        if l.startswith(">"): n=l[1:]; d[n]=""
        elif n: d[n]+=l.strip()
    return d

lysk=list(up("accession:Q6Y7T6").values())[0]; chapK=lysk[:165]; a=enc(chapK)
seqs={}
seqs.update({("phage",k):v for k,v in up("xref:pfam-PF05257 AND taxonomy_id:10239 AND length:[100 TO 700]",150).items()})
seqs.update({("bacteria",k):v for k,v in up("xref:pfam-PF05257 AND reviewed:true AND length:[100 TO 700]",80).items()})
POS={"D45 (Ca)":45,"D47 (Ca)":47,"Y49 (Ca, main-chain O)":49,"H51 (Ca, main-chain O)":51,"D56 (Ca)":56,
     "C54 (catalytic Cys)":54,"H117 (catalytic His)":117,"E134 (catalytic Glu)":134}
recs=[]
for (grp,hdr),s in seqs.items():
    if len(s)<80: continue
    sco,mp=sw_map(a,enc(s))
    if sco<60: continue
    row=dict(group=grp,acc=hdr.split("|")[1] if "|" in hdr else hdr[:10],score=sco,
             aln=len(mp), pid=round(100*sum(1 for k,v in mp.items() if chapK[k]==s[v])/max(len(mp),1),1))
    for lab,p in POS.items():
        j=mp.get(p-1); row[lab]= s[j] if j is not None else "-"
    recs.append(row)
R=pd.DataFrame(recs); print("homologs aligned:",len(R), R.group.value_counts().to_dict())

stats=[]
for lab,p in POS.items():
    wt=lysk[p-1]; v=R[lab]; aln=v[v!="-"]
    chem = {"D45 (Ca)":set("DNE"),"D47 (Ca)":set("DNE"),"D56 (Ca)":set("DNE"),
            "Y49 (Ca, main-chain O)":set("YWFHLVIAMGST"),"H51 (Ca, main-chain O)":set("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY"),
            "C54 (catalytic Cys)":set("C"),"H117 (catalytic His)":set("H"),"E134 (catalytic Glu)":set("ED")}[lab]
    stats.append(dict(position=lab, wt=wt, n_aligned=len(aln),
        pct_identical=round(100*(aln==wt).mean(),1),
        pct_chem_compatible=round(100*aln.isin(chem).mean(),1)))
Cdf=pd.DataFrame(stats)
print(Cdf.to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14.5,5))
ax=axes[0]
o=Cdf.iloc[[5,6,7,0,1,4,2,3]]
cols=["#C62828"]*3+["#2E7D32"]*5
ax.barh(o.position[::-1], o.pct_identical[::-1], color=cols[::-1])
for i,(p,val,n) in enumerate(zip(o.position[::-1],o.pct_identical[::-1],o.n_aligned[::-1])):
    ax.text(val+1,i,f"{val:.0f}%  (n={n})",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(0,118); ax.set_xlabel("% identical to CHAP$_K$ among aligned homologs")
ax.set_title(f"Conservation across {len(R)} PF05257 CHAP homologs\n(red = catalytic triad, green = Ca$^{{2+}}$ ligands)")

ax=axes[1]
pdb_tab=pd.DataFrame([
 ("4CSH LysK CHAP$_K$","Ca",1,"Zn",1),("4CT3 LysK CHAP$_K$ (MeHg)","Ca",1,"none",0),
 ("4OLK LysGH15 CHAP","Ca",1,"none",0),("6IST LysIME-EF1","Ca",1,"none",0),
 ("8H1I PlyGRCS","Ca",1,"none",0),("8XYF PlyGRCS holo","none",0,"none",0),
 ("4F88 PlyC (PlyCA CHAP)","none",0,"none",0),("2K3A S. saprophyticus CHAP","none",0,"none",0),
 ("11CF lysin L1 CHAP","none",0,"none",0),("11CG lysin L2 CHAP","none",0,"none",0),
 ("9R7G PcsB CHAP C292A","none",0,"none",0),("5D74 Ly7917","none",0,"none",0),
 ("5D76 Ly7917+MDP prod.","none",0,"none",0),("5T1Q S. aureus amidase","none",0,"none",0),
 ("4CGK PcsB","none",0,"none",0),("3A2Z Gsp amidase","none",0,"none",0)],
 columns=["structure","ca","has_ca","zn","has_zn"])
y=np.arange(len(pdb_tab))
ax.barh(y-0.2,pdb_tab.has_ca,0.4,color="#2E7D32",label="Ca$^{2+}$ bound")
ax.barh(y+0.2,pdb_tab.has_zn,0.4,color="#C62828",label="Zn$^{2+}$ bound")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(pdb_tab.structure,fontsize=8); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["absent","present"]); ax.legend(frameon=False)
ax.set_title("Metal occupancy across all CHAP-domain structures in the PDB\nZn occurs in 1 of 16; Ca occurs in 5")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
